column1: # Files whose Chinese disappeared because the file itself was removed, and why
# that removal was correct. Read by `scripts/l10n-guard.sh`.
# Format: <path>\t<reason>   ("#" starts a comment; a reason is mandatory)
# Two things this list can never do, by construction of the guard:
#   * excuse a path that still exists at --after with its Chinese stripped out.
#     That is the upstream-clobber case, and it is reported regardless of what
#     is listed here;
#   * keep working after the path comes back. An entry naming an existing path
#     is reported as stale and has to be deleted, so the list cannot accumulate
#     permanent exemptions.
# A rename is NOT listed here: if the Chinese lines reappear verbatim at another
# path, the guard classifies it as `moved` on its own.

# `crates/codegen/xai-grok-pager/src/views/usage_modal.rs`；状态栏「累计 token」chip 改为派发
